name: Swiss Poster
author: Marinara Engine
description: Swiss poster. Off-white paper by day, black card stock by night, one red. Inter throughout, hairline rules, a 3px rule to open every section, and one red sun sinking behind a ground band on Home. Long replies are set in one 36em column (about 65 characters a line) that the message box and every turn rule share; avatars hang in the margin and the speaker's name stays pinned while you read. Follows the time of day.
